answer: Pairwise uniqueness challenges tax every fake identity with irreplaceable human time. Each epoch, identities pair up for a brief Q&A and log it: a ripple across an ocean of strangers tying two presences together. A farm of N puppets faces N squared over two pairings, so 100 puppets burn 50,000 human-hours per epoch and a nebula of fakes collapses margins to zero. One honest agent spends 10 minutes once and earns an oasis of verified uniqueness.
